properties.caption: A fire from flipbooks: looping flame tongues faded frame into frame, embers on a swirl, heat haze bending the air, and smoke lit by the sun and the fire through a normal map. The demolition range on the beach shows the rest.
properties.title: VFX

properties.caption: The fire crackles where it burns - walk round it. A thrown crate thuds where it lands.
properties.title: Audio

properties.caption: Every character plays clips from the rig it was imported with. This one shows them in turn - idle, walk, run, jump - crossfading between them.
properties.title: Animation

properties.caption: generateSphere's spheres: dielectric then metal, rough from left to right; then clearcoat, sheen, anisotropy, a cut-out and a transparent pane.
properties.title: Materials

properties.caption: Ragdolls, joints and characters on an obstacle course: dominoes, a Newton's cradle, wrecking balls, a seesaw, towers to topple. G throws a crate; F knocks a player down.
properties.title: The Course

properties.caption: Walk across the keys. Each one sings when a player steps on it - every player hears every player's tune.
properties.title: Floor Piano

properties.caption: Walk the ramp twice round the tower. From the top you can see every area of the lab.
properties.title: Viewpoint

properties.caption: Every part of the engine, one small world to play in. North: the course - physics. East: the gallery - real models, area lights, mirrors. South: the beach, the demolition range and the sea. Tokens hide all over - M opens the map.
properties.title: The Lab

properties.caption: East: The Gallery  South: Beach, Range  North: The Course
properties.title: This Way

properties.caption: Crates and buoys bob on the waves: each asks the ocean how high the water is under it (OceanSurface::sampleAt). The lighthouse sweeps the sea at night.
properties.title: Beach and Pier

properties.caption: Real models: cloth, leather, chrome, brass, lacquer and glass under area lights. The floor and the mirror are planar reflectors - they show what is behind you.
properties.title: The Gallery

properties.caption: Press E at the red detonator. Flipbook fire and lit smoke, sparks that bounce, a shockwave that bends the air - and every body near it thrown by physics.
properties.title: Demolition Range
